title: The hero: heat walks the four corners of the die, then the middle

predicted.what: Each phase minus the five-phase cycle mean puts one warm lobe at that phase's own place, and the lobe steps round the board. The confirmatory statistics are the ten pairwise constant-power swaps: NW<->SE +153 mK over 21.015 mm (the longest travel this die offers), NE<->SW +136 mK over 18.596 mm, the four sides +81 to +112 mK, and the centre against each individual corner +61 to +77 mK -- quoted WITH the electrical correction below, never as a clean confirmation. Arrival lag 38 deg = 13.5 s at the 127.5 s lap. This block also measures, for free, the blur anisotropy r that E62-NS42's amplitude ratio needs: the lobe widths along the NW-NE baseline (15.372 mm, the W-E family) and the NW-SW baseline (14.800 mm, the N-S family) give it directly.
predicted.direction: four lobes at four distinct image positions whose bearings span the plane, stepping round a CLOSED LOOP in the sense set by the fitted handedness k -- which E62-WE42 and E62-NS42 determine two and three blocks later, so neither a compass word nor a sense is claimed here -- and then collapsing to the middle. The two diagonal difference directions are 98.6 deg apart, NOT opposed: the IO/PCIe corner makes the four arms a trapezoid, not a rectangle.
predicted.basis: the anchor scaled by centroid travel, switched watts and dwell: 372.9 mK x (travel / 10.012 mm) x (5.2 W / 14.40 W) x 0.542. Centroid travel from placements.py; no absolute mK in the chain.

anchor.formula: 372.9 mK x (travel_mm / 10.012) x (switched_w / 14.40) x (transfer(dwell_s) / transfer(41.7 s))

pass_rule: PASS if the four corner phases land at four image positions that are mutually separated by more than 3x the per-cycle position scatter, their bearings span the plane, THE ANGLE BETWEEN THE NW-SE AND NE-SW DIAGONAL DIFFERENCE DIRECTIONS IS 98.6 +/- 12 DEG (not 180: the two diagonals of a quadrilateral are never opposed, and the IO/PCIe corner makes these four arms a trapezoid -- version 1's criterion demanded a geometry that correct data could only fail), every phase's board power is inside +/-0.3 W of the others, and every phase-minus-mean monopole is null (|card mean| < 25 mK, permutation p > 0.1). The signed falsifier is PROTOCOL.md section 7.7 check 3, the NE<->SW diagonal at 36.6 +/- 10 deg from the measured W->E direction. FAIL -- and the reading is 'the regulators, not the die' -- if the lobe does not move, or if the four positions collapse onto fewer than three distinct places. +/-0.3 W, tightened from +/-0.5 W, because B4C's own feature vector is (0, 0, 0, 0) against NW (1, 2, 0, 0), NE (2, 0, 2, 0), SE (1, 2, 0, 1) and SW (1, 2, 0, 0): the CENTRE arm is the most mismatched of the five, and the C-minus-corner dipoles are only +61 to +77 mK against the session's own ~34 mK price for an electrical half-die asymmetry. If the measured B4C-versus-corner power spread exceeds +/-0.3 W, the centre result is reported as EXPLORATORY alongside the ring statistic. The centre phase's radial contrast against the ring mean is exploratory in either case (DECISIONS section 4).

drift_leak.note: the arm order alternates, so the time offset averages to 0.0 s and a drift cannot masquerade as the dipole
